LanguageData.CS_Kandra_TakeFormDesc: Rearrange into one of the bodies this kandra has eaten. Takes ten seconds. Forms known: {COUNT}.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_NoFormsYet: This kandra has not taken anyone's bones yet.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_RevertDesc: Drop the borrowed shape. Others find the sight of a kandra's own body hard to sit with.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_PickFormTip: Click to take this shape. It takes about ten seconds.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_LeaveAnimalDesc: Step out of the animal and back into the kandra's own body. Whatever this shape has suffered stays with it.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_FreeFormDesc: Put together a face nobody has ever worn. No bones needed; the kandra has done this enough times to invent one.
LanguageData.CS_Kandra_FreeFormLocked: Shapeshift {LEVEL} required. Until then it can only wear what it has eaten.
